subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub add first-class shareable cron-template packages, reuse skills/plugins with conventions, or defer scheduled-job sharing until an OpenClaw runtime install contract exists?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested surface, and recurring automation templates need maintainer-owned product, runtime, moderation, and consent boundaries before implementation can be scoped safely.

options.title: Design a first-class template model
options.body: Define the artifact schema, preview/install semantics, moderation checks, trust labels, and runtime consent contract before building the catalog.

options.title: Use existing skills or plugins
options.body: Treat cron templates as ordinary skills or bundle plugins only if install remains explicit and the runtime contract is documented elsewhere.

options.title: Defer scheduled installs
options.body: Leave the current catalog unchanged until OpenClaw exposes a safer scheduled-job import or plugin API.

recommendation.title: Design a first-class template model
recommendation.body: Define the artifact schema, preview/install semantics, moderation checks, trust labels, and runtime consent contract before building the catalog.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the strongest current-history owner for the package/catalog schema, API docs, and product-scope guardrails this decision would affect.
